title: Achieving Goal of 80% Green Mark Buildings by 2030
what_it_is: Achieving Goal of 80% Green Mark Buildings by 2030

sections.label: Green Mark buildings target
sections.summary: Singapore aims for 80% Green Mark buildings by 2030, with laws for new projects and financing for existing buildings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) whether Singapore is on track to achieve the goal of 80% Green Mark buildings by 2030; (b) what is being done to improve the uptake rate among private sector buildings; (c) whether there are plans to make the BCA Green Mark Scheme compulsory; and (d) whether the Ministry will consider mandating the use of renewable energy in buildings that are eligible.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We are still aiming to reach the target of 80% by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: All new projects and major retrofitting works are already required by law to meet environmental sustainability standards that are equivalent to the minimum Green Mark certification level.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To encourage owners of existing buildings to green their buildings, the Building and Construction Authority (BCA) also provides financing arrangements where building owners can obtain financing from participating financial institutions and pay off the loan through the energy savings that they reap.

sections.label: Green Mark progress and target
sections.summary: 40% of gross floor area has Green Mark certification, with a target of 80% and legal requirements for new projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, let me just assure the Member that, yes, we do look at various criteria.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Certainly, today, we have done quite okay in terms of getting 40% of all possible GFA on the Green Mark.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Our target is 80% and certainly there is work to be done.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But as I mentioned in my reply earlier, today, all new projects and major retrofitting works are already required by law.

sections.label: Air-conditioning Green Mark requirements
sections.summary: Green Mark certification requires new and retrofitted buildings to keep temperatures at 23 to 25 degrees Celsius and meet chiller efficiency standards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: As for air-conditioning, as part of the Green Mark certification, one of the things that we require of all the new buildings and retrofitted buildings is to keep the temperature at 23 to 25 degrees Celsius.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: That is one thing that is being stated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: And, as a minimum design requirement, there are certain efficiency standards that will be required of their chillers and air-condition systems.
